name: gibbering mouther
desc: Gibbering Mouther is a CR 2 aberration.

actions.name: aberrant ground
actions.desc: The ground in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=uNtJ0Zvj5SXxoaNm]] around the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is doughlike &reference[difficult terrain]. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: gibbering
actions.desc: The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't &reference[incapacitated apply=false]. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and can hear the gibbering must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a [[/r d8]] to determine what it does during its turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .lfUDtJ8hdeULQzqa]]{Bite} attack and, if it can, uses its [[/item .KQRvDGowc6ihejLu]]{Blinding Spittle}.

actions.name: bites
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be knocked &reference[prone]. If the target is killed by this damage, it is absorbed into the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

actions.name: blinding spittle
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=lIu1LNYAMT8FLBjR]] of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be &reference[blinded apply=false] until the end of the mouther's next turn.
